correctness.rationale: The 2x2 transfer-matrix trace u+vz and determinant -h*z produce F_{n+2}=(u+vz)F_{n+1}+hzF_n with stationary F1. Negative simple roots follow the interlacing sign proof, in accord with Dekking-Kong prior real-root theorem. For z=-t the characteristic roots are conjugate on (t-,t+) and yield an exact real cosine phase with increasing theta(t), theta(t-)=0, theta(t+)=pi. Bounded phase derivative on compact subintervals gives n*(theta(s)-theta(r))/pi+O(1) zeros there; taking band margins to zero forces the remaining fraction to vanish. Thus weak density theta_prime/pi equals the claimed formula; pushforward p=1/(1+t) gives Bernoulli-parameter law. Independent exact-rational recurrence vs 2-state path enumeration succeeded for nine small cases; numerical root scans are not infinite certification.
residual_risks: Finite checks do not prove all parameters; universal proof depends on the mathematical lemmas and hypotheses explicitly reconstructed in RESULT.md.
